description.p: Murmur types what you say into whatever app has focus. Press a shortcut, talk, and your words appear at the cursor about a second behind your voice. Press the shortcut again to stop. You can keep typing and clicking normally the whole time.
Speech recognition runs entirely on your computer. The only network access is the one-time download of a speech model. No audio or text leaves your machine.

ul.li: Works in every app: words are typed wherever your cursor is
Punctuation and capitalization from the default model, in 25 European languages
A tray icon shows when it is listening, and the microphone is open only while dictating
The speech model is loaded on demand and freed again when idle
KDE Plasma 6.1 or later, or GNOME 48 or later
xdg-desktop-portal with the KDE or GNOME backend (usually installed with the desktop)
On GNOME, the AppIndicator extension for the tray icon (dictation works without it)
